C08-M09-L07-F1.title: Evidence needed for phishing scope claims
C08-M09-L07-F1.caption: Record the strongest claim supported by the available sources for each asset or identity.
C08-M09-L07-F1.alt: Four rows compare the evidence for delivered, user interaction, executed and compromised. The sources are message trace, user or session evidence, endpoint process telemetry, and corroborating security records. The table lists blocked delivery, automated previews, routine processes and unlinked events as limitations.
rows: User statement or qualified session event
C08-M09-L07-F1.note: Report the strongest supported claim and its limits.
